## Summary

## Parts

- Rear backing plate [t633]
- Torque member, axle shaft bearing cage [t633]

## Tips & gotchas

- Consider replacing the ABS sensor rotor if it is damaged, as it sits inside the axle shaft bearing cage. [t633]
- Replace the four nuts holding the axle shaft bearing cage every time they are removed. [t633]
